limitations_and_boundaries: The study primarily uses the MMTV-Neu mouse model and MCF10A human cell lines; generalizability to other breast cancer subtypes or species is not established.
The in vivo LOX inhibition experiments were performed in parous mice, which may not fully recapitulate nulliparous tumorigenesis.
The role of other ECM components and crosslinking enzymes beyond LOX was not explored.
The study does not directly measure integrin-GFR crosstalk at the molecular level; the proposed mechanism is inferred from pharmacological and genetic perturbations.
Long-term effects of LOX inhibition on normal tissue homeostasis were not assessed.
The selected source chunks do not report a rescue, reconstitution, reversal, or epistasis experiment; that rung of the causal evidence chain remains untested within this extraction scope.
